TC-18/S25.title: Billing prompt and citation rules match the prototype or have Vikram's approval (todo: TFA-94229)
TC-18/S25.detail: Todo — T1 belongs to TFA-94229 (in progress). Recorded: #110 rewrote the billing prompts (billing.md v1.7: the model lists 2023 AMA MDM problems / data / risk as enum categories with the numbers of the note sentences that support them, no level, no code, no reasoning; billing-system.md; new billing-discharge-time.md: durations with exact quotes). The app derives the level by two-of-three and the code from a fixed table, and shows the cited sentences. This follows Vikram's 2026-09-29 / 10-01 direction recorded on TFA-92596 (structured MDM, code computed in code, final note as the only evidence); an approval of the v1.7 wording itself was not found here.
